cariboo.title: Burned chimney all that remains of woman’s home after wildfire near Clinton, B.C.
cariboo.description: A resident from British Columbia's Cariboo region says there’s nothing left around her property other than her burnt-out chimney stack and her neighbour’s propane tank.

all.title: Canada wildfire smoke blankets US skies across the Midwest and Northeast, triggering health alerts
all.description: Air quality levels are forecast to drop to unhealthy levels across the U.S. Midwest and Northeast on Tuesday as smoke from Canadian wildfires intensifies. AirNow’s Fire and Smoke Map showed the regions blanketed in yellow due to the drifting smoke. all.title: B.C. wildfires expected to grow as hot, windy conditions return
all.description: The Pear Lake wildfire, estimated at 66,000 hectares, received some reprieve from the cooler, wetter weather. However, the weather is warming up again.
